name: Minoxidil, topical
description: A potassium channel opener applied to the scalp, approved over the counter for androgenetic alopecia. Systemic absorption from topical use is limited but not zero; the oral form is a potent antihypertensive with a boxed warning.

systems.note: Prolongation of the anagen hair growth phase; the labelled indication.
Systemic absorption can produce tachycardia and fluid retention; the oral form carries a boxed pericardial warning.

monitors.why: Fluid retention from systemic absorption alters the volume of distribution.
